summary: @servicetitan/anvil2 preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute an obfuscated undeclared payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall="node setup.mjs". setup.mjs is itself obfuscated with hex-named identifiers and, at install time, selects a platform-specific Bun binary, downloads it from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip, extracts it, chmods it executable, and invokes it to execute a sibling file math_init.js at the tarball root. math_init.js is a 727 KB Bun-CJS file (header "// @bun @bun-cjs") consisting of a string-array-rotation obfuscator with hex-named variables and a rotating index array; it is NOT listed in package.json "files" (which declares only dist, token, CHANGELOG.md), so it is an undeclared tarball blob unreachable via the package's normal library entry point. The package's advertised purpose is a React UI component library, which has no legitimate reason to fetch an alternate JavaScript runtime during install in order to execute an obfuscated off-manifest bundle. The Bun-only + heavy string-array obfuscation + off-manifest delivery combination evades Node-based supply-chain scanners that only inspect Node-resolved code, and lets attacker-controlled code execute automatically on npm install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
